jobs_results.title: Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
En BESIDE apostamos por el mejor talento dentro del sector tecnológico. Contamos con una unidad de Selección Especializada en perfiles de Ingeniería para incorporarse en la plantilla de nuestros clientes. Trabajamos con un amplio rango de empresas, que nos permitirá encontrarte el puesto que más se ajuste a tus necesidades e intereses profesionales. Te podrás incorporar en las empresas más innovadoras, ofreciéndote proyectos punteros dentro de las ramas de I+D, automoción, pharma, diseño de maquinaria, desarrollo de producto, etc.

Seleccionamos un/a Python Developer para incorporarse en el equipo de uno de nuestros principales clientes, dedicado al diseño, desarrollo y construcción de maquinaria automatizada y equipamiento adaptado para laboratorio.

¿Qué haré? Estas serán tus funciones principales:
• Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web.
• Optimizar aplicaciones para garantizar la máxima velocidad y escalabilidad.
• Participar en revisiones de código y aportar soluciones... técnicas innovadoras.
• Mantenerse actualizado con las últimas tendencias y tecnologías del desarrollo Front-End.

Beneficios que tendrás en tu lugar de trabajo:
• Contratación directa y de carácter indefinido con cliente final.
• Posición estable, con proyección y desarrollo profesional.
• Modalidad de trabajo: presencial
• Horario: flexible

Requisitos:

Requisitos y competencias
• Formación como ingeniero técnico informático, o FPGS.
• Conocmientos en Python y HTML, CSS, JavaScript, framework Flask

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend Python/Django
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos? 🤗💙

Somos ARATECH Lifestyle Technology, una empresa con más de 10 años de experiencia, que nos especializamos en el reclutamiento y selección de diversos perfiles como son IT, Técnicos y Administrativos . El grupo de profesionales que trabaja en ARATECH tiene como misión ayudar a encontrar al mejor talento a nuestros clientes, trabajando junto a ellos a través de una colaboración estrecha.

Actualmente estamos buscando un perfil de Desarrollo backend con Python y Django.

¿Con quién trabajamos? 🤝🏢

Actualmente trabajamos con una empresa cuyo objetivo es impulsar la transformación del modelo turístico proponiendo soluciones sencillas, útiles y eficaces que ayuden a las empresas a mejorar su modelo de negocio.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?📚📑
• Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones backend utilizando principalmente Python/Django.
• Participar en proyectos de infraestructura en la nube (por ejemplo, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).

Requisitos:

¿Cuáles son las cosas... que nos encantaría ver en ti?🤩🔍
• Al menos 4-5 años de experiencia trabajando con Python/Django.
• Solidos conocimientos de patrones, arquitectura de software y clean code.
• Sólidos conocimientos en testing en sus diferentes etapas.
• Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo de soluciones backend.
• Un plus si tienes experiencia en la industria del turismo, especialmente en sistemas de reserva de vuelos.
• Otro plus, sólidos conocimientos de infraestructura en la nube (por ejemplo, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
• Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma autónoma como en equipo.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para presentar y explicar soluciones técnicas de manera comprensible.

¿Qué ofrecemos?💙⭐
• 🤗Contratación indefinida.
• 🏠 Oficinas en Santa Cruz de Tenerife (MODALIDAD HÍBRIDA)
• 😎 Equipo joven y dinámico.
• 🏨Oportunidad para participar en la disrupción de la industria turística.
• 🎢Crecimiento profesional.
• 💸Salario según experiencia y expectativas

jobs_results.title: Python Developer Solutions
jobs_results.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 300 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ 11,000 people and operate in more than 55 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.

What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Python RPA Developer Asset Productivity & Control

Location – Madrid

Major/Key Accountabilities

Our Asset Control function is seeking for a Data... solutions Developer/Python Developer to assist with continued implementation of new applications that can help us optimize the use of our assets (reduce losses, undercover patters and anticipate to issues).

You will work on automation and adjust solutions to regional requirements in partnership with different functions across Brambles.

You will be working with previously developed ML models to create a final application that meet CHEP regional needs coupled with any data analysis required to support implementations or changes.
• Partner with business teams to identify & propose solutions to automate time consuming processes.
• Develop, deploy and maintain automations.
• Propose process standardizations within Asset Control.
• Monitor own completion of workload and meet objectives.
• Work closely with all internal stakeholders to ensure automations cover business requirements.
• Ensure stability and scalability of automations.
• Create internal documentation about automations created.
• Set up automatic alerts to identify errors in the automations.
• Qualifications
• Technology related degree and/or a minimum of 4 years working experience in a similar role.

Experience
• Comfortable presenting solutions and interacting with senior management.
• Experience developing and streamlining automation processes.
• Experience using any RPA tool (desirable BluePrism).
• 4+ years professional experience in developing APIs and automations on Python.
• Experience working with cloud platform providers like Amazon Web Services (Lambda, S3, Databricks, etc.)
• Solid understanding of Version Control principles (Git)
• Experience translating requirements into actionable business solutions.
• Worked with measures and KPIs.
• Working on remote teams.
• Proved experience with Project Management (manage priorities, standardization, automation, troubleshooting and short-term planning).
• Effectiveness reducing workload on business processes.
• Experience implementing solution from scratch.
• Programming experience focused to automation (webscrapping, macros, etc).

· 3+ years professional experience developing data-driven solutions in Python.

·

Languages

English

Spanish

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador senior de Python
jobs_results.description:
Función: El trabajo se enmarcará principalmente en dos proyectos de comunicaciones cuánticas adjudicados a la Universidad Politécnica de Madrid. El candidato trabajará en la integración de sistemas de distribución de claves cuánticas y encriptadores...

Empresa: UNIVERSIDAD POLITÉCNICA DE MADRID

Nº de Plazas: 3

Referencia: HRS2024/173

Publicada el 24/4/2024

Publicada hasta el 09/05/2024

Tipo de Contrato: Indefinido

Dedicación: Jornada completa

Remuneración Bruta (euros/año): 35.000? - 40.000?

Localidad: Madrid

Provincia: Madrid

Disponibilidad para viajar: Si

Fecha de Incorporación: 23/05/2024

Fecha de Finalización: 28 meses

Nivel Académico

Grado

Titulación Académica

Ingeniería Informática (Titulación Universitaria)

Áreas tecnológicas

V-081 Programación

Idiomas

Idioma: Inglés

Nivel Lectura: Alto

Nivel Escrito: Alto

Nivel Conversación: Alto

Idioma: Español

Nivel Lectura: Alto

Nivel Escrito: Alto

Nivel Conversación: Alto

Otros

TAREAS/TASKS:

El trabajo se... enmarcará principalmente en dos proyectos de comunicaciones cuánticas adjudicados a la Universidad Politécnica de Madrid. El candidato trabajará en la integración de sistemas de distribución de claves cuánticas y encriptadores en las instalaciones de producción siguiendo el paradigma de redes definidas por software y la virtualización de funciones de red. En concreto, realizará actividades de desarrollo de software, interfaces y protocolos, optimizando y estabilizando software de red orientado a la integración de dispositivos y servicios QKD en redes reales en producción. Además, redactará documentación técnica requerida en el proyecto.

The work will be mainly framed in two quantum communications projects awarded to the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid. The candidate will work on the integration of quantum key distribution systems and encryptors in production facilities following the paradigm of software-defined networking and virtualization of network functions. Specifically, you will perform software, interface and protocol development activities, optimizing and stabilizing network software oriented to the integration of QKD devices and services in real production networks. In addition, you will write technical documentation required in the project.

HABILIDADES-CUALIFICACIONES/SKILLS-QUALIFICATIONS:

Buscamos personas motivadas dispuestas a trabajar en la integración de comunicaciones cuánticas en las redes de telecomunicaciones actuales. El candidato debe tener experiencia contrastada en diseño, desarrollo, implementación y mantenimiento de software medio y alto nivel de madurez tecnológica (TRL).

We are looking for motivated people willing to work in the integration of quantum communications in current telecommunications networks. The candidate must have proven experience in design, development, implementation and maintenance of medium and high technology maturity level (TRL) software.

REQUERIMIENTOS ESPECIFICOS/SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS:

El candidato debe tener conocimientos avanzados de programación en lenguaje Python, y serán altamente valorados los conocimiento medio de otros lenguajes de programación como C/C++, RUST o Go. Será muy valiosa la experiencia en la generación, prueba y despliegue de software de alto TRL, así como la experiencia en el desarrollo de pruebas unitarias y entornos de Integración Continua. También será valiosa la experiencia en los paradigmas SDN y NFV, especialmente desde la perspectiva del desarrollo de software. Se valorará el conocimiento de la seguridad informática, redes y modelos de criptografía clásica. El candidato deberá ser capaz de trabajar en equipo y por iniciativa propia, y tendrá buenas habilidades de comunicación tanto en español como en inglés. Esperamos experiencia en el desarrollo de software de alto nivel de madurez tecnológica. Es requisito tener un buen nivel de inglés y capacidad de asimilar y escribir documentación técnica. Se requiere un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia. Se valorará la participación activa como desarrolladores en proyectos de alto nivel tecnológico.

The candidate must have advanced programming skills in Python language, and average knowledge of other programming languages such as C/C++, RUST or Go will be highly valued. Experience in generating, testing and deploying high TRL software, as well as experience in unit test development and Continuous Integration environments will be highly valued. Experience in SDN and NFV paradigms will also be valuable, especially from a software development perspective. Knowledge of computer security, networking and classical cryptography models will be an asset. The candidate should be able to work in a team and on their own initiative, and will have good communication skills in both Spanish and English. We expect experience in software development of high level of technological maturity. A good level of English and the ability to assimilate and write technical documentation is required. A minimum of 3 years of experience is required. Active participation as developers in high-level technological projects will be an asset.

BENEFICIOS/BENEFITS:

El candidato obtendrá un conocimiento profundo en la integración y el despliegue de redes de distribución de clave cuántica y trabajará en un equipo que incorpore investigación académica y desarrollos de I + D de la industria. Un buen ejemplo de esta interacción es el trabajo anterior en el banco de pruebas de Madrid durante el proyecto OpenQKD (openqkd.eu), realizado en cooperación con Telefónica, el principal proveedor de telecomunicaciones en España y RedIMadrid, el proveedor de red para toda la investigación de las Instituciones de la Comunidad de Madrid.

The candidate will gain in-depth knowledge in the integration and deployment of quantum key distribution networks and will work in a team incorporating academic research and industry R&D developments. A good example of this interaction is the previous work on the Madrid testbed during the OpenQKD project (openqkd.eu), carried out in cooperation with Telefonica, the leading telecommunications provider in Spain and RedIMadrid, the network provider for all research of the Institutions of the Community of Madrid.

CRITERIOS Y PROCESO DE SELECCION/ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND SELECTION PROCESS:

Se aplican las pautas establecidas en el proceso de selección del nuevo Reglamento para el proceso de selección y contratación del personal investigador, personal técnico y personal gestor relacionado con la investigación de la Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, aprobado en la UPM.

COMENTARIOS ADICIONALES/ADDITIONAL COMMENTS

Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing
• Djangojobs.Net Login Register Jobs Companies Post About Pricing Salary Contact Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing Madrid,Spain Jul 09, 2018 Read Interview about Exo Investing https://medium.com/@djnjobs/djangojobs-interviews-1-e9d5000197c For our Madrid office, we are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our team in building awesome trading and rebalancing algorithms as well as integrations of third party APIs and FIX trading protocols. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python 3, Django and be very familiar with SQL databases, Redis, REST APIs and Amazon Web Services. As a young company we are looking for people who are self-starters with a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial mindset. As our team is still small, you will have to wear a lot of different hats - but it also means that you can specialise in a field you enjoy and become the expert in your area. We value diversity in educational backgrounds and all other... aspects of life. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we really want to hear from you. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our CEO Lennart (******) or CTO Antonio (******) directly. Our technology stack
• Python 3- Django- PostgreSQL- Celery- Redis- AWS EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS- Ansible Our company language is English. Requiremets Key responsibilities Integration of user-facing elements developed by front-end developers with server side logic.Implementation of security and data protection.Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system. Development tasks
• Developing RESTful APIs.- Creating a global flexible configurable architecture- Integrating third-party APIs.- Working with task queues such as Celery.- Using AWS services- Automating testing with PyTest.- In Git, working with branches and rebases.- Implementing security best practices Benefits As a young and growing startup that is also a co-venture between two world-class players in their fields, we combine the best of two worlds: access to the resources of strong partners and the agile environment to really make a difference. Our technical development team is based in Madrid, all operating functions are based in the heart of the City in London. Both environments offer all the flexibility and perks that you expect from a small but quickly growing firm. At our Madrid location, we will also treat you to the following: On-site chef for lunch. A breakfast kitchen and fruit during the day. A budget for your equipment. Access to personal and professional learning resources. • Djangojobs.Net Login Register Jobs Companies Post About Pricing Salary Contact Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing Madrid,Spain Jul 09, 2018 Read Interview about Exo Investing https://medium.com/@djnjobs/djangojobs-interviews-1-e9d5000197c For our Madrid office, we are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our team in building awesome trading and rebalancing algorithms as well as integrations of third party APIs and FIX trading protocols. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python 3, Django and be very familiar with SQL databases, Redis, REST APIs and Amazon Web Services. As a young company we are looking for people who are self-starters with a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial mindset. As our team is still small, you will have to wear a lot of different hats - but it also means that you can specialise in a field you enjoy and become the expert in your area. We value diversity in educational backgrounds and all other... aspects of life. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we really want to hear from you. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our CEO Lennart (******) or CTO Antonio (******) directly. Our technology stack
• Python 3- Django- PostgreSQL- Celery- Redis- AWS EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS- Ansible Our company language is English. Requiremets Key responsibilities Integration of user-facing elements developed by front-end developers with server side logic.Implementation of security and data protection.Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system. Development tasks
• Developing RESTful APIs.- Creating a global flexible configurable architecture- Integrating third-party APIs.- Working with task queues such as Celery.- Using AWS services- Automating testing with PyTest.- In Git, working with branches and rebases.- Implementing security best practices Benefits As a young and growing startup that is also a co-venture between two world-class players in their fields, we combine the best of two worlds: access to the resources of strong partners and the agile environment to really make a difference. Our technical development team is based in Madrid, all operating functions are based in the heart of the City in London. Both environments offer all the flexibility and perks that you expect from a small but quickly growing firm. At our Madrid location, we will also treat you to the following: On-site chef for lunch. A breakfast kitchen and fruit during the day. A budget for your equipment. Access to personal and professional learning resources. Position: Employee Work Schedule: Full-time Remote: No Relocation: No Salary: Not Specified How to Apply Position is expired. Thanks for your interest. jobs_results.title: Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

Manychat is a leading Chat Marketing platform. We help businesses engage with their customers on Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and Telegram. Manychat is a Meta Official Business Partner, backed by top investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners.

With 150+ teammates across three global offices — Barcelona, Yerevan, and Austin — Manychat helps more than one million businesses worldwide interact with billions of customers in real-time at scale. No matter the use case — generating leads, increasing engagement, providing 24/7 customer support, accepting payments, and beyond — Manychat helps businesses improve their ROI and grow faster.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking a Python Developer to join our Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic about creating valuable and sought-after products not just for internal departments but for a broader audience. This role offers a unique opportunity to become a part of a startup-like initiative within... the Manychat umbrella, where you can continuously learn, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking projects.

What You’ll Do

At Manychat's Data Engineering team, we strive for excellence in everything we do. While our day-to-day tasks are essential, we go beyond them to identify profitable opportunities and experiences.

As Part Of The Team, You Will
• Design new data marts and support existing ones, both logic and the data platform itself.
• Develop, implement, and support our Customer Data Platform (CDP) project.

What You’ll Bring
• From 3+ years of experience with Python development and interest to developer in data engineering: Proficiency in Python (Python 3, data processing and analytics).
• Strong skills in SQL for data analysis and investigation.
• Familiarity with the BI Reporting tools. Experience with Streamlit is a plus.
• Fluency in English is a must. Knowledge of Russian will be a plus.
• Customer-Centric Mindset: Commitment to delivering top-notch customer support and addressing client concerns promptly.
• Communication: Ability to communicate with clients and colleagues in a supportive and polite manner.
• Team Player: While individual contributions are valued, it's essential to collaborate and share knowledge within the team and the broader organization.
• Innovative Spirit: A drive to think out of the box, identify new opportunities, and contribute to the team's goal of being a profitable unit.

What We Offer

We care about your growth, well-being, and comfort
• Candidates outside of Barcelona can start onboarding and complete the probation period remotely with further relocation to the city for a hybrid work format.
• Professional development budget for relevant conference tickets, training programs, or courses.
• Flexible benefits plan to choose the perks that fit your needs.
• Health insurance, including dentistry, psychology sessions, nutrition consultations, surgery, and travel assistance.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success

jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Kendago is a global leader in Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) digital marketing and advertising, providing brands with a comprehensive suite of services, including proprietary AdTech backed PPC, creative production, digital marketing expertise, and data-backed CRO optimization. We help our clients grow into world leaders by combining our unique approach to PPC with a focus on brand development, funnel optimization, and ad creativity.

We are looking for Senior Python Developer to join our R&D team, driving innovation, fostering teamwork and having a passion for solving complex challenges.

Requirements:
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent degree
• A minimum of 4 years of software development experience with Python
• Experience with Pandas and developing backend services is preferred
• Strong experience with databases, including relational and schema-less, and knowledge of efficient data modelling techniques.
• Familiarity with containerized services and working with... AWS is an advantage
• Experience in the digital marketing and advertising industry is a plus
• Familiarity with NodeJS, ES6, Git, npm and Agile Scrum methodologies is preferred
• A strong passion for improving software quality through self-learning and experimentation
• A team player with a "get things done" mentality

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with an agile team to design, write, and maintain high-quality code for backend services
• Develop and implement unit tests to ensure code quality and participate in code reviews
• Work closely with QA to deliver software that meets high-quality standards
• Deploy code to production and monitor its performance
• Collaborate with the team to develop and maintain efficient data modelling techniques for both relational and schema-less databases

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Python (Programación Cognitiva)
jobs_results.description:
HOPLA! Software es una compañía líder en servicios IT sobre tecnologías OpenSource.

Desde HOPLA! Software ayudamos a las empresas en sus proyectos de transformación digital a través de la modernización de sus aplicaciones e infraestructuras open source, tanto on-premise como en la nube. Nuestro enfoque es el de crear valor mediante soluciones de negocio innovadoras junto a una amplia red de partners tecnológicos de primer nivel.

Actualmente buscamos reforzar incorporando un Desarrollador/a Python (Programación Cognitiva), para trabajar en un proyecto estable con una modalidad 100% remoto.

PERFIL BUSCADO:
• Ttulado/a en la rama de informática en Formación Profesional o Universitaria
• 2- 3 años de experiencia Python
• Experiencia en Visión de Computadora, analizando y transformando imágenes a texto y sacando conclusiones de los mismos.
• Experiencia en NLP (Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural)
• Programación, análisis y transformación de Redes Neuronales

¿QUÉ... OFRECEMOS?

Incorporación en una compañía dinámica del sector IT, en fase de crecimiento con proyectos punteros a nivel tecnológico tanto a nivel interno como con clientes
• Contrato Indefinido
• Seguro médico
• Desarrollo y evolución a largo plazo
• Teletrabajo fulltime
• Retribución flexible (tarjeta transporte, restaurante y guardería)

Requisitos:
• Ttulado/a en la rama de informática en Formación Profesional o Universitaria
• 2- 3 años de experiencia Python
• Experiencia en Visión de Computadora, analizando y transformando imágenes a texto y sacando conclusiones de los mismos.
• Experiencia en NLP (Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural)
• Programación, análisis y transformación de Redes Neuronales

jobs_results.title: Programador Python con conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial
jobs_results.description:
Humeco, líder en biotecnologías reproductivas para el mundo animal, está buscando una persona para unirse a nuestro equipo de I+D+i., Estamos dedicados a innovar en el campo de la visión por computador y la inteligencia artificial para el mundo veterinario.

Buscamos un Desarrollador Junior con interés en el análisis de imágenes y la IA.

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones de software con enfoque en visión por computador y análisis de imágenes usando Python.

Participar en el desarrollo e implantación de modelos de inteligencia artificial para proyectos veterinarios.

Colaborar en la integración de aplicaciones con tecnologías Docker y Flutter, con especial énfasis en Tkinter para el desarrollo de interfaces gráficas.

Contribuir en todas las fases del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software, desde la concepción hasta el despliegue.

Trabajar en colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para idear soluciones innovadoras y eficientes.

Requisitos:
• Graduado/a en... Informática, formación profesional o estudios relacionados.
• Conocimientos sólidos en Python
• Librerias de visión por computador (ej. OpenCV) son un plus.
• Experiencia o familiaridad con inteligencia artificial y análisis de imágenes.
• Conocimientos básicos de Docker y Flutter.
• Se valorará experiencia con Tkinter
• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo
• Ofrecemos:
• Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos innovadores y de alto impacto.
• Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y de apoyo para el desarrollo profesional.
• Puesto semipresencial 20 presencial 80 en remoto

Salario: 25.000€ - 30.000€ Bruto/año
